description: List current (unresolved) health-based drinking water violations from EPA SDWIS: maximum contaminant level (MCL), maximum residual disinfectant level (MRDL), and treatment-technique violations whose status is Unaddressed or Addressed. Monitoring and reporting violations are excluded. Filter by state, by PWSID, or by contaminant code; most recent compliance periods first.
name: get_current_health_violations
